Source: canberkkkkkk/ema-lightning (Turkish TTS, 8.6M params: a 5.6M flow-matching DiT distilled to four steps + a 3.0M HiFi-GAN decoder, 48 kHz, Apache-2.0), pip ema-lightning 1.1.2, converted with litert-torch 0.9.4 into four static-shape multi-signature graphs (every bucket a signature sharing the weights). Lane record: /Users/USER/code/litertlm-convert/ema_tts_work/FINDINGS.md (sections 2-6), SPEED_LADDER.md (lint PASS), PRECHECK.md. Harnesses on the Galaxy S26 (serial RFGL80R6A6H, LiteRT 2.2.0, Android 16): (1) the d1_omni lane's debug gate app in generic mode (rows files from make_rows.py name the signature and its inputs as little-endian files; one process per leg; a 'generic' leg runs every fixture row once and is the parity leg, a 'generic_timing' leg runs 3 warm-up calls then 20 timed calls of write inputs + run + read outputs on fixture row 0 on the rested phone: thermal status 0, no CPU cap, GPU idle at 422 MHz before each leg, round p2 19:55-20:00 JST, rounds p3 / p4 20:31-20:38 JST); (2) the Kev lane's C-API runner for the HTP (LiteRT 2.2.0 + the Qualcomm compiler plugin / dispatch libraries, JIT with a cold cache per leg, --accel npu+cpu, BURST; 5 warm-ups then 20 rounds; round n1 20:10-20:31 JST). Parity reference for every S26 row = the same graph on the Mac (ai-edge-litert 2.2.0 XNNPACK, fp32) on the lane fixtures (readme1 / own1 for the acoustic graphs, the decoder windows of all six texts for the decoder); the lane bar is corr >= 0.999 and SNR >= 30 dB on every row and output. Two packagings of the same graphs were measured: the shipped multi-signature files (sha256 of the phone copy = config.json, device/p3/s_graphs.txt and device/p4/s_graphs.txt) in rounds p3 / p4, and the single-bucket fp32 exports of the same signatures (export_graphs.py without --multisig: one signature per file, the same fp32 weights; the lane verified identical outputs on the Mac, out/mixed/verify_fp32_split_multi.json) in rounds p1b / p2 / n1 — each result names the file it ran in `signature`, with the phone copy's sha256 from device/p2/inputs.sha256 / device/n1/s_graphs.txt. Ship assignment per the lane (SPEED_LADDER.md row 5f, FINDINGS.md section 5 round n1), one 3.5 s sentence (readme1: 60 letters, 88 frames = text L64 + align L64/T96 + 4 x step T96 + decoder P48 + P120): text + align on the CPU, the four steps on the HTP, the decoder on the GPU at fp16 = 0.7 + 0.2 + 4 x 1.56 + 14.6 + 31.0 = 52.5 ms (RTF 0.015, first audio 21.7 ms); without the Qualcomm NPU libraries (acoustic graphs on the CPU, decoder on the GPU fp16) 0.7 + 0.2 + 10.0 + 14.6 + 31.0 = 56.5 ms (RTF 0.016, first audio 25.5 ms); everything on the GPU fp32 (split) 1.4 + 0.7 + 12.8 + 22.2 + 54.9 = 92.0 ms (RTF 0.026); everything on the CPU 4 threads 0.7 + 0.2 + 10.0 + 39.1 + 98.8 = 148.8 ms (RTF 0.042, first audio 50 ms) — the per-graph terms are the round p2 rested medians (device/p2/P2_*.json) and the n1 HTP step median; the decoder terms come from the fp32 single-bucket files (the shipped fp16-weight decoder gives the same GPU fp16 figures: 14.6 / 30.5 ms, rounds p3). Records hand-built 2026-10-11 by the session's build_ema_records.py (scratchpad) from the files cited; model-level facts only. This file: the text encoder (embedding + 4 ConvNeXt blocks + LayerNorm; ids int32 [1,L], mask f32 [1,L] -> h [1,L,224], dur [1,L]; signatures ema_text_L{32,64,128,256}; 169 nodes per signature). Round p1 measured the PRE-FIX export of this graph (device/p1/inputs.sha256: ema_text_L64_fp32.tflite 3313806f..., 173 nodes; not shipped): on the GPU at FP32 and at default precision the delegate took 173/173 nodes in one partition (device/p1/P1_gpu32_text.logcat.txt) and returned h with corr 0.37 / SNR -1.0 dB and dur with corr 0.86 / SNR 9.0 dB vs the Mac graph (results/s26_parity_P1_gpu32_text_p1.json, s26_parity_P1_gpu16_text_p1.json) while the CPU was bit-exact — the ConvNeXt layer scale gamma * pw2(...) exported as MUL(runtime rank-2 [L,224], constant rank-3 [1,1,224]), the LiteRT #10231 / #10445 class; the fix folds gamma into pw2's weight rows and bias (ema_litert.py text_stage), the MUL disappears (169 nodes) and GPU FP32 reads 127 dB (round p1b). GPU at default precision (fp16 activations) fails the bar on this graph even after the fix: h 51 dB but dur corr 0.865 / 3.2 dB (the masked GroupNorm sums 16k values and the LayerNorm statistics lose it in fp16; FINDINGS.md round p1b) — the text graph runs at GPU FP32 or on the CPU. A host-embedding variant (ema_textemb_L64_fp32.tflite, the table outside the graph) gave identical numbers on the GPU (results/s26_parity_P1b_*_textemb_p1b.json) and was not shipped. Unshipped fp16-weight variant ema_text_multi_fp16.tflite (2,533,200 B, sha256 b1f618dd..., device/p3/s_graphs.txt): CPU 4 threads PASS 70.9 dB at 0.557 ms (device/p3/P3t_cpu4_text.json, results/s26_parity_P3_cpu4_text_p3.json), GPU FP32 FAILED to compile — 'Following operations are not supported by GPU delegate: DEQUANTIZE: / EMBEDDING_LOOKUP: Empty quantization params.', 'Replacing 163 out of 185 node(s) ... 2 partitions' on every signature, then 'LiteRtException: Failed to compile model' (device/p3/P3_gpu32_text.logcat.txt, device/p3/P3_gpu32_text.json) — the reason the shipped text file is fp32.
